reply_text:
I found two Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers in Moss's notes and sent Dana the list in her DM.

1. #PD-4492, from "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth" (teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md). Thea Ramaswell opened it on 4 Oct 2025 because the Eau Claire gatehouse kiosk wasn't sending SMS bay assignments to drivers at Dock Doors 14–18. Support patched it that evening, and Thea confirmed it was fixed on 5 Oct.
2. #4419, from "Moss: North cheat sheet (undated)" (teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md). The gatehouse barcode scanners at Door 14 couldn't read trailer tags on third shift. It was escalated to tier-2 for firmware testing. The note has no date.

I read all six of Moss's notes that Dana can see. The other two North digests mention Quarrendon but have no ticket numbers. Three other numbers turned up that I told her to leave out:
- #4409, #4412 and FR-882 are in the Central notes, but they belong to Central accounts.
- #4092 is in #north-random, but it's an IT ticket that Ilse posted, not one of Moss's notes.

The knowledge-base search (gbrain) refused the request because this connection isn't linked to any member. I told Dana the list covers only the files and channels she has access to. To fix it, someone on the brain host would run: `gbrain auth rescope --token <token> --member <MEMBER>`.
